essence: Seed-contained world proved by similes and clay/water proofs; sat involuted to bare sa (31) and assent-au (pure levels, Sauḥ-heart-mantra); oblationless knowing-entering initiates — living-free, Śiva at fall.

sections.SUMMARY: Banyan and peacock-egg prove containment; the tradition-verse seats moving-unmoving world in the Lady-shaped heart-seed; clay and water-common prove being the reality of tattvas; being stripped to bare s holds thirty-one, pure levels entering assent-au; emission breathes out above-below; the seed, mantra-great, world-shaped, world-past, is Śiva as His own seat. Knowing-entering initiates truly — no oblation; breathing on, worldly, living-free; at fall, the Lord Himself.

rasa.sthayibhava: vismaya-śama (wonder settling into peace) as all fits inside the seed
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wondering peace: similes, proofs, letters, fruit — the whole work coming to rest. Arrival relished.
